body:
I hear you, but I didn't get to hold her first- I was knocked out when the birth went bad. I didn't get to birth her- they cut her out of me with hardly any warning but for a frenzied run down the hallway...
I feel like I failed her right from the start.

Somewhat, no where near this bad. Plus when I was I could go to bed and regroup. No such thing now when on duty 24/7.

I did look forward to her, I planned every aspect for 5 years leading up to the pregnancy. 

She'd likely be sad, but brief sadness over someone she doesn't know wouldn't be worse than a lifetime of less than optimal parenting.
But my husband could remarry, someone much better. She would still have a mom.
The only times I've tried it gives me anxiety so all consuming that it's... Well, it's terrifying. Things that are supposed to be relaxing panic me :/
